It builds a temp path by stripping the extension from the default directory string byte_5EA438 and appending the 'tmp' suffix, clears read-only attributes on both the temp and destination names, logs the attempt, initializes a small struct, loads the directory list and dispatches vtable callbacks over it, closes the file handle, then initializes the settings file, parses the config into the global dword_7C73E8, deletes the old destination and renames the temp file over it, logs the result, and frees the small struct before returning 0.
